_meta.model: Shinku_Swimsuit base.pmx (10 materials, all on leaked Blender defaults 0.8/1.0@11.899/0.4 = none real, P20)
_meta.conventions: diffuse (1,1,1,a); specular (0,0,0)@5.0; ambient 128/255 head+hair, 192/255 costume, 1.0 eye highlight; edge 0.5 black, reddish on face only; no sphere, no toon (reference-matching).

materials.name: 目影
materials.rationale: P19 fix, re-verified on THIS mesh: eye_bantou.json tints its light blue-grey texture (sampled RGB 0.376/0.459/0.518, alpha 0.380 at the material's own UVs) with BaseColor BLACK under MSM_Unlit/Translucent. The same UVs on T_player_076_shinku_face_d sample a dark opaque swatch (0.169/0.114/0.107) - the look UE actually produces. Rebound to face_d with diffuse alpha 0.5, matching the reference 目影 idiom. Edge off: bOverrideOutlineOverlayMaterial=true with NO OutlineOverlayMaterial. Tri count 76 == reference 目影 76.

materials.name: 顔
materials.flags_explain: 0x1F = two-sided + ground shadow + self-shadow map + receive self-shadow + edge ON
materials.rationale: MI_player_076_shinku_face supplies a DEDICATED face outline material (.../outline/face/MI_player_076_shinku_face) -> edge ON with the reference's reddish face edge (128/255, 64/255, 64/255). Sampled skin tone 0.915/0.731/0.713 at own UVs confirms binding. Tri 5378 == ref.

materials.name: 睫毛
materials.rationale: MI_eyelash BaseColor == face_d (sampled dark lash swatch 0.235/0.127/0.119 at own UVs). outline override present but NO outline material -> edge OFF. Tri 1704 == reference 眉睫 1704.

materials.name: 瞳
materials.rationale: MI_eye BaseColor = eyes_d (sampled dark iris 0.091/0.023/0.023). outline explicitly none -> edge OFF. Tri 240 == reference 目 240.

materials.name: 目ハイライト
materials.rationale: MI_gaogaung BaseColor = eyes_d; sampled pure white 1.0/1.0/1.0 at own UVs. Ambient 1.0 so the highlight never darkens (reference value). Edge OFF. Tri 160 == reference 目hl 160.

materials.name: 衣装_01
materials.flags_explain: 0x1F = two-sided + ground shadow + self-shadow map + receive self-shadow + edge ON
materials.rationale: Albedo is Textures.BaseColor = swimsuit_01_d; PM_Diffuse points at the _id region mask (P19 trap, not the albedo). Outline material player_076_swimsuit_cloth_01 -> edge ON. Costume ambient 192/255. Matcap1..6 slots present in UE but not wired as sphere maps, matching the reference (no sphere textures anywhere) and Fashion 1's measured rejection of the same matcap family.

materials.name: 衣装_02
materials.flags_explain: 0x1F = two-sided + ground shadow + self-shadow map + receive self-shadow + edge ON
materials.rationale: BaseColor = swimsuit_02_d (PM_Diffuse is the _id mask). Outline material present -> edge ON. Costume ambient 192/255.

materials.name: 髪_01
materials.flags_explain: 0x1F = two-sided + ground shadow + self-shadow map + receive self-shadow + edge ON
materials.rationale: BaseColor = swimsuit_hair_01_d. Outline MI_player_076_shinku_hair1 -> edge ON. Hair ambient 128/255 (reference head-part value). Texture has real alpha cutout (15%% of sampled texels < 0.5, min 0.0) - masked strand tips; texture alpha carries it, diffuse alpha stays 1.0.

materials.name: 髪_02
materials.flags_explain: 0x1F = two-sided + ground shadow + self-shadow map + receive self-shadow + edge ON
materials.rationale: BaseColor = swimsuit_hair_02_d. Outline MI_player_076_shinku_hair2 -> edge ON. Hair ambient 128/255.

materials.name: 衣装_03
materials.flags_explain: 0x1F = two-sided + ground shadow + self-shadow map + receive self-shadow + edge ON
materials.rationale: BaseColor = swimsuit_03_d (PM_Diffuse is the _id mask). Outline material present -> edge ON. Costume ambient 192/255.

findings: All 8 texture bindings verified by sampling each texture at the bound material's own UVs; zero mis-assignments.
eye_bantou inversion present exactly as in Fashion 1; fixed by rebinding to the face atlas dark swatch with diffuse alpha 0.5.
Head-part triangle counts match the reference exactly (目影76 顔5378 睫毛1704 瞳240 目HL160), so reference head-part floats are ground truth for those materials.
risks: 衣装 draw order is inherited from the model (opaque cutout only, no large translucent areas measured: min alpha >= 0.996 on 衣装_01/02/03, 髪_02); only 髪_01 uses cutout alpha and it draws after 顔 (index 7 > 1).
